title: Shift Calendar Maker
description: Build a monthly shift rota from a rotation pattern (e.g. DDNNOOOO for 2 days, 2 nights, 4 off): color-coded calendar, shift totals and print view.
howto: Type your rotation pattern with D = day shift, N = night shift, O = off (e.g. DDNNOOOO).
Pick the month and the date your current cycle starts (day 1 of the pattern).
Press Generate to render the color-coded month calendar with shift totals.
Use Print for a clean paper copy of the rota.

faqs.q: How do I write the pattern?
faqs.a: One letter per day in cycle order: D day, N night, O off. 'DDNNOOOO' means 2 day shifts, 2 night shifts, then 4 days off, repeating. Letters are case-insensitive.
The date on which day 1 of your pattern falls. If today you are on the second night of DDNNOOOO, set the start date 2 days earlier so the pattern lines up.
Yes — the Print button produces a clean black-and-white-friendly layout of the current month.
